title: Serotonin reuptake inhibitors and hyperprolactinaemia: a case/non-case study in the French pharmacovigilance database
authors: Trenque T, Herlem E, Auriche P, Dramé M
population: Spontaneous adverse drug reaction reports to the French Pharmacovigilance Database, 1985 to December 2009; 11,863 reports with serotonin reuptake inhibitors, 187 of hyperprolactinaemia
funder: not read: the publisher full text is behind a paywall.
result: Reporting odds ratio for hyperprolactinaemia with serotonin reuptake inhibitors 3.3 (95% CI 2.8 to 3.8): fluvoxamine 4.5, citalopram 3.9, fluoxetine 3.6, paroxetine 3.1; sertraline, duloxetine and milnacipran were not associated with increased reporting. Spontaneous reports give no incidence. Results read from the abstract.
